metadata.title: German A2 Verbs
metadata.scope: A2-only verb curriculum: verbs in the Goethe-Zertifikat A2 reference list whose dictionary forms are not already present in the accompanying expanded a1_verbs.json.
metadata.cumulativeUse: Load a1_verbs.json together with this file for cumulative A1–A2 practice.

sources.name: German verbs database derived from Wiktionary
sources.usage: Morphological cross-check; semantic exceptions were overridden

notes: The Goethe A2 vocabulary list is cumulative; this file intentionally contains only dictionary forms not already included in the expanded A1 file.
For cumulative A2 study, combine a1_verbs.json and a2_verbs.json.
The file includes forms beyond the minimum productive A2 examination requirements so learners can enable or disable categories in settings.
Native-speaker editorial review is recommended before production release, especially for valency, less common imperatives, and context-dependent auxiliary choices.
